summary: Genesis 14:5 names Ham in its account of Chedorlaomer’s campaign. There the kings struck the Zuzim.

senses.definition: The place where Chedorlaomer and his allies struck the Zuzim.

evidence.note: The phrase וְאֶת הַזּוּזִים בְּהָם pairs the Zuzim with Ham, just as the surrounding phrases pair the Rephaim and the Emim with the places of their defeat.
